description: Search the 0 restaurants participating in NYC Restaurant Week Summer 2026 (Jul 20 – Sep 6). All filters are optional and combinable. Prix-fixe tiers are $30 / $45 / $60 for lunch, brunch, or dinner. Saturdays are excluded program-wide; Sunday participation varies. Returns a paginated list with total count — use get_restaurant with a slug for menus, reservation and website links.

bookable_on_opentable.description: true = only restaurants reservable via OpenTable

cuisine.description: Cuisine filter, e.g. Italian, Japanese / Sushi, Steakhouse, French, Korean, Mexican, Seafood, Indian, Thai (see list_filters for all 50+)

date.description: A specific date (YYYY-MM-DD) you want to dine — resolves to the right week and handles Saturday/Sunday rules

has_menu.description: true = only restaurants that published their Restaurant Week menu PDF

neighborhood.description: e.g. Tribeca, West Village, Astoria, Williamsburg (see list_filters)

price.description: Maximum prix-fixe price per person: 30, 45, or 60

query.description: Free-text search over name, description, cuisine, and neighborhood (e.g. 'rooftop', 'omakase', 'steak tribeca')

sunday.description: true = only restaurants offering Restaurant Week on Sundays

week.description: Program week 1–7 (Week 1 starts Jul 20, Week 7 ends Sep 6)

name: search_restaurants
